instruction: Can you increase the maximum volume limit in VLC to 200? I sometimes work with audio files that have low recording levels, and I need the ability to boost the volume beyond the default maximum.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting the maximum volume in VLC to 200. Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric function to verify the qt-max-volume setting is set to 200 in the VLC configuration file.
